title: Drifter Desserts Cream Donut 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cream Donut by Drifter Desserts brings together the soft, doughy flavour of a fresh Donut with a smooth cream filling. Each puff layers gentle sweetness with rich, creamy undertones, recreating the taste of a familiar bakery favourite in a satisfying vape format. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid ensures a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, discreet vapour production, and clear flavour delivery. Perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, it’s compatible with starter kits, vape pens, and refillable pod systems. Choose from 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths for tailored satisfaction. Drifter Desserts is part of the Drifter range by UK-based Juice Sauz, a brand renowned for authentic flavour blends and quality ingredients. Perfect for refillable vape and vape starter kits for smooth, consistent performance.
